script:
set -e
TOK=$(cat ~/.cache/huggingface/token)
curl -sfL -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOK" -o /tmp/h.ply https://huggingface.co/datasets/miguelemosreverte/alambique-datasets/resolve/main/checkpoints/kazbek-run-h-max/kazbek-run-h-max.ply
export DENO_INSTALL=$HOME/.deno
command -v $DENO_INSTALL/bin/deno >/dev/null 2>&1 || (curl -fsSL https://deno.land/install.sh | sh -s -- -y >/dev/null 2>&1)
cd /workspace/image-generation && export GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0; timeout 60 git fetch -q origin main && git reset -q --hard origin/main || true
STAGE=/workspace/lod-stage-32/world/kazbek-c10
mkdir -p $STAGE
$DENO_INSTALL/bin/deno run --allow-read --allow-write /workspace/image-generation/splat-viewer/build-octree.ts /tmp/h.ply $STAGE/octree-h-g32 --grid 32 --proxy-stride 8 --proxy-inflate 2
python3 -c "from huggingface_hub import HfApi; HfApi().upload_large_folder(folder_path='/workspace/lod-stage-32', repo_id='miguelemosreverte/alambique-datasets', repo_type='dataset', print_report=False)"
echo LOD-G32-DONE
